answers.observation: Image inspection cannot establish authority by itself, but the bound build and independent audit show zero target keys, zero actor pose keys after release, Blender/Bullet final-pose ownership and exact reopen.
The selected impact frame shows all five targets simultaneously moving at visibly distinct angles. It is a propagated collision moment rather than the earlier first-contact frame.
The sampled sequence progresses continuously from initial contact through increasing lean to collapse. The wave travels along the row without a pose jump or discontinuous final-state substitution.

The five targets do not share one uniform horizontal pose. Two retain approximately 62-degree tilts and the result includes solver-produced support, overlap and scatter that read as discovered rather than arranged.
Setup, propagated impact and settled aftermath use separate evaluated semantic bounds; all bodies remain readable while composition responds to the physical state.

The primary motion is credible, but the scene remains a polished stylized demonstration. It lacks shutter-visible motion blur, compliant contact response, secondary physical layers, environmental detail, surface wear and sound.

softwareLessons: Treat the physics timeline as measured data: select cinematic moments from evaluated multi-body motion, not from an authored frame number or first contact alone.
Permit reproducible variation only in bounded initial conditions such as position, yaw, friction and restitution; never use variation as authority over final transforms.
Require both state provenance and visual review: screenshots judge legibility, while keyframe and reopen receipts prove that an attractive result was not posed.
Preserve primary collision truth before adding secondary effects. Motion blur, compliant contact, debris, dust or sound may enrich the event but must not conceal a weak rigid-body solve.
Use a simple causal curriculum as the training ground, then return these generic rules to the robot capstone as an unseen holdout.
limitations: The accepted scope covers rigid-body propagation and deterministic initial-condition richness for one five-target fixture, not broad scene generalization.
The ball currently functions as a clean causal actor but does not yet show realistic rolling texture motion, impact compression or audible contact.
Photoreal materials, motion blur, deformation, particles, dust, sound and a complex character scene remain outside this acceptance.
